character.name: Varic
character.background: Disgraced nobility, falsely accused of treason
traits: Stoic Resolve: Never shows pain, fear, or doubt, even when gravely injured or outmatched.
Haunted by Betrayal: Has advantage on saving throws against illusion magic that recreates the night of his arrest, as the memory is too vivid to be fooled.
Unyielding Honor: Will never break a promise, even to enemies, and will not strike a foe who has surrendered.
Grim Pragmatist: No longer trusts divine magic or holy symbols, relying solely on his martial skill and wits to survive.
character.gear: Dented steel shield · Scuffed splint armor (house crest removed) · Family heirloom longsword · Cracked holy symbol of the Silver Dawn · 3 days of iron rations · Bottle of bitter wine · Treason-marked noble signet ring · Concealed thieves' tools
character.story: Varic was the last knight of extinguished House Varric, sworn to the Oath of the Silver Dawn. When King Alden's brother was murdered, Lord Malakar framed Varic for treason. The paladin order demanded Varic renounce his oath to spare his life, but he refused, choosing to break it himself rather than swear loyalty to the corrupt king who condemned him. He escaped execution, and now wanders frostbitten borderlands hunting the traitors. His sword is sharp, his honor unbroken, his vengeance patient. He will not rest until Malakar bleeds for his lies, or his name is cleared.

inventory.name: Family Heirloom Longsword
inventory.lore: Forged for Varic's great-grandfather, the blade never dulled even when used to cut through siege chains. The treasonous lord who framed Varic tried to have it melted down, but the loyal smith hid it in the city sewers until Varic retrieved it on the night of his exile.
inventory.description: A well-worn steel longsword with a leather-wrapped hilt, the pommel etched with the crest of Varic's extinct noble house. It hums faintly when held by a trueborn member of the line.

inventory.name: Dented Steel Shield
inventory.lore: Once bore the silver sun crest of Varic's house, now scraped raw to hide his identity from the king's men who still hunt him. The large dent in its face came from the first blow of the guard who tried to arrest him on the night of his exile.
inventory.description: A heavy steel shield, dented and scratched, with no remaining markings of its former house.

inventory.name: Scuffed Splint Armor
inventory.lore: Issued to Varic when he was knighted, the interlocking steel plates are still strong but bear deep scratches from the fight he put up when the king's guard burst into his manor to arrest him. The house crest was chiseled off the breastplate by the traitorous lord to publicly humiliate him.
inventory.description: Heavy splint armor, scuffed and dented, with the chiseled-off remains of a noble crest on the breastplate.

inventory.name: Cracked Holy Symbol of the Silver Dawn
inventory.lore: Given to Varic when he took his paladin oath, the silver sun disc glowed with soft divine light until the night he was accused of treason. The crack runs from the top to the base, and no divine magic will respond to it now, a constant reminder of his broken oath.
inventory.description: A silver disc etched with a rising sun, split down the middle by a jagged crack. It is cold to the touch, with no lingering divine magic.
inventory.effects: Once per day, as a bonus action, Varic can pour a fragment of his own will into the symbol. It glows with faint, cold blue light for 1 minute, revealing invisible creatures and objects within 30 feet, and suppressing divination magic targeting him for the duration.

inventory.name: Treason-Marked Noble Signet Ring
inventory.lore: Bears the crest of Varic's ancestral house, now overstamped with a false mark of treason by the lord who framed him. He wears it under his gauntlet, a reminder of the lie that destroyed his life and the vow he made to see it corrected.
inventory.description: A silver signet ring, the original crest of a noble house half-obscured by a jagged, false mark of treason.

inventory.name: Iron Rations
inventory.lore: Standard issue for knights on long campaign, these dense cakes of dried meat and grain are hard as stone but never spoil. Varic has carried them since the night he fled the capital, never knowing when he would next have a safe place to eat a proper meal.
inventory.description: Three small, dense cakes of preserved food, wrapped in oiled cloth.
inventory.effects: Eating one restores 1d4+1 hit points and satisfies hunger for a full day.

inventory.name: Bitter Wine
inventory.lore: A gift from Varic's younger sister on the day he was knighted. He has only taken a single sip since his exile, saving the rest for the day he clears his name or avenges his family's ruin.
inventory.description: A small glass bottle of dark red wine, still half-full, with a faded wax seal bearing his sister's mark.
inventory.effects: Drinking the wine grants advantage on Wisdom saving throws against fear effects for 1 hour, but imposes disadvantage on Charisma checks for the same duration, as the bitterness of his memories clouds his mind.

inventory.name: Concealed Thieves' Tools
inventory.lore: Stolen from a band of cutpurses he interrogated in the slums of the capital, these tools have helped him sneak into enemy strongholds and avoid the king's men who still hunt him across the borderlands.
inventory.description: A set of lockpicks, tension wrenches, and small files, concealed in a leather sheath tucked into Varic's boot.
inventory.effects: Allows Varic to pick locks and disarm traps with proficiency, even without the Thief proficiency.
